protocol.name: FPMR-1 — Funding-Pressure Momentum Rotation
protocol.claim: A cross-alt residual trend is more persistent when its relative funding pressure is easing, while a weak residual trend with worsening funding pressure continues to underperform over the following week.

novelty_boundary.versus_dcrm: combines cross-sectional residual level, one-week residual rotation, and the change in a 28-day realized-funding burden; DCRM used only a 30-day residual level plus dispersion sizing
novelty_boundary.versus_afch: funding is a crowding-change predictor, not the harvested payoff; the pair is selected by price/funding interaction and held seven days
novelty_boundary.versus_current_portfolio: one beta-neutral alt pair, no BTC leg, REX, OI, Kimchi, FX, DXY, premium-index gate, tree, Markov state, LLM, or manual regime

universe.position: one long alt and one short alt; no BTC leg

source_contract.funding: exact reported funding rate and settlement timestamp

feature_formula.leave_one_out_factor: per-symbol median completed hourly return of the other five alts
feature_formula.residual_30d: 30-day return minus clipped beta times 30-day factor return
feature_formula.residual_rotation: current residual_level_z minus its value seven days earlier
feature_formula.funding_pressure_change_z: same-boundary population z-score of current_28d minus prior_28d
feature_formula.weights: positive gross-one weights satisfying long_beta*w_long = short_beta*w_short

clock.decision_time: Monday 00:05 UTC after the 00:00 funding settlement
clock.same_boundary_order: close old pair before opening the new pair

execution.cost_applied: entry and exit on both legs by absolute notional
execution.strict_mdd: global/pre-entry HWM; entry, exit, and hypothetical liquidation costs; exact funding; favorable-before-adverse two-leg OHLC
execution.cagr: full declared calendar including warm-up and idle cash

frozen_controls_not_repair_candidates: entry and exit delayed five minutes
ten basis points per notional side

orthogonality_after_standalone_pass.compare_against: all promoted/live/shadow sleeves on one marked ledger

protocol.stop_rule: Reject before outcomes if support fails. Otherwise freeze the strict evaluator, open 2023 exactly once, and retire on any gate failure without opening 2024 or changing the score, sign, hold, weights, or execution.
